info.title: Queue OpenAPI for tripo3d/p2/image-to-3d
info.description: The OpenAPI schema for the tripo3d/p2/image-to-3d queue.

P2ImageTo3dInput.title: P2ImageTo3DInput
P2ImageTo3dInput.description: Input for Image to 3D generation using the P2 model.

texture.title: Texture
texture.description: Whether to generate textures for the model.

auto_size.title: Auto Size
auto_size.description: Auto-scale the model to real-world dimensions in meters.

image_url.title: Image Url
image_url.description: URL of the input image for 3D model creation.

quad.title: Quad
quad.description: Generate quad mesh topology instead of triangles.

face_limit.title: Face Limit
face_limit.description: Maximum number of faces for the generated mesh. Quad meshes support up to 25,000 faces.

export_orientation.title: Export Orientation
export_orientation.description: Optional forward axis for the exported model.

pbr.title: Pbr
pbr.description: Whether to generate PBR material maps. Enabling PBR also enables textures.

enable_safety_checker.title: Enable Safety Checker
enable_safety_checker.description: Authorized callers may set false to request relaxed screening.

texture_version.title: Texture Version
texture_version.description: Texture model version. The fast quality requires v3.5-20260815.

export_uv.title: Export Uv
export_uv.description: Whether to generate UV coordinates for the model.

delight.title: Delight
delight.description: Remove baked-in lighting before texturing with v3.5-20260815.

task_id.title: Task Id
task_id.description: Tripo task ID for a generated model. Pass this to rig or rig-check to use the model without uploading it again.

model_mesh.description: Generated 3D model file. May be GLB or FBX depending on Tripo output.

rendered_image.description: Preview render of the generated 3D model.

file_name.title: File Name
file_name.description: The name of the file. It will be auto-generated if not provided.

file_size.title: File Size
file_size.description: The size of the file in bytes.

content_type.title: Content Type
content_type.description: The mime type of the file.

url.title: Url
url.description: The URL where the file can be downloaded from.

schema.description: Whether to include logs (`1`) in the response or not (`0`).

success.description: Whether the request was cancelled successfully.
